Burnish is a mastering suite for Ableton Live. Eighteen modules (equalisers,
multiband and vintage dynamics, a true-peak Maximizer, exciter, imager,
tape, bass and spectral tools) go in any order on one signal chain, with
loudness metering, gain-matched bypass and dither. ASSIST listens to the
song and builds a chain toward a genre target or a reference track. Put it
last on the master channel.

## Install

Unzip and copy `Burnish.vst3` into your VST3 folder (macOS
`~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3`, Windows `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3`,
Linux `~/.vst3`), then rescan plug-ins in Live. The guide (PDF) in the
download tours the panel, walks you through a first session and covers
every module.

**macOS:** the plugin isn't notarised. If macOS refuses to load it, run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/Burnish.vst3`.
